gaps.title: Missing LTI Protocol Single Sign-On Integration
gaps.jtbd: When a user attempts to log in from Moodle via an LTI launch request, I want the archive to authenticate the user session using LTI protocol parameters, so that seamless embedded LMS navigation is supported.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an LTI launch request from Moodle with valid launch parameters and signature, When received by the authentication controller, Then the system authenticates the user, synchronizes their role and department, and returns a valid session token.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly requires Moodle SSO supporting '(OAuth2 / OIDC / LTI)', but LTI launch protocol handling is completely absent from the application code.

gaps.title: Missing Moodle Role Hierarchy Display and Management Endpoint
gaps.jtbd: When an administrator views or updates Moodle role mappings, I want an API endpoint and UI view to display and adjust Moodle role hierarchy mappings, so that role synchronization rules are visible and configurable.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated administrator, When requesting Moodle role hierarchy mappings or submitting a role override via `/api/v1/auth/moodle/override-role`, Then the system returns the current role hierarchy mapping and updates the user role.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement and broken frontend integration: Brief requirement 2 specifies 'отображение иерархии ролей Moodle в ролевую модель архива', and frontend component MoodleRoleOverride.svelte attempts to call POST /auth/moodle/override-role which does not exist on the backend.
